title: Abbas alam tera maqtal se aa raha hai
body:
Abbas alam tera maqtal se aa raha hai ..
Shabbir ki qamar ko haae jhuka raha hai ..
1
Ye alam husainiyat ki pehchan hai karaata,
Yehi yazidiyat ke hai farq ko batata,
Koi chumta hai aa kar ..
Koi utha raha hai ..
2
Deti thi dilase mai aega abhi paani
Sab milke dua mango gazi ki hai jawani
Kyu khali alam baba
Khaimo me aa raha hai ..
3
Mushkil khusha ka beta karta hai yu bayazi
Kuch mang kr to dekho deta hai mera gazi
Hai hath alam par jo
Gazi bula raha hai ..
4
Zainab ki khaimagah se awaz aisi aayi
Chadar ka jo wada tha wapas hu lene aayi
Tatheer ka muhaafiz
Marne ko jaa raha hai ..
5
Mamnoon tera hu mai padhna sikha diya hai
Sardar ko is kaabil maula bana diya hai
Teri wafa ki baate
Sabko suna raha hai ..
